categories.main_business_segments: Chun Yu Works & Co., Ltd. primarily engages in manufacturing and trading various steel products, machinery, and tools, including screws, nuts, wood screws, polished wire rods, spheroidized steel, and iron wire. The company also provides heat treatment, steel pickling, surface treatment, and pollution control equipment design and contracting services. Additionally, it handles waste acid and waste disposal, as well as manufacturing and trading waste acid and iron oxide products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced forging and machining technologies for screws and bolts, including patented screw forming methods and torque-controlled high-strength bolts. It utilizes heat treatment, electroplating, and surface coating processes to enhance product durability and corrosion resistance. The firm also integrates automated quality inspection equipment such as Auto-Checkers and optical sorting machines, and focuses on green manufacturing processes including acid recycling and low-carbon product development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Chun Yu serves a diverse range of industries including automotive, aerospace, railway systems, construction, electronics, and machinery manufacturing. Its products are sold globally, with significant markets in Taiwan, Hong Kong, Mainland China, the United States, and other countries. The company targets both domestic and international customers, focusing on high-value niche markets such as aerospace and new energy vehicles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan with manufacturing facilities in Kaohsiung and subsidiaries in Mainland China (Dongguan and Shanghai), Indonesia, and the United States. Its sales markets cover Asia, North America, Europe, and other global regions, with export sales accounting for a substantial portion of revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chun Yu operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing and processing steel-based fasteners and components. It sources raw materials such as steel wire rods from upstream steel producers and supplies finished products downstream to various manufacturing industries and end users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D to enhance product quality, develop new manufacturing processes, and reduce production costs through green materials and technologies. It focuses on low-carbon product development, energy efficiency, and automation to support sustainability goals. Future R&D plans include improving machining precision, automating production, and developing specialized fasteners for electric vehicles, rail transit, and pollution control equipment.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of manufactured steel products, including screws, nuts, and machinery components. The company also earns income from providing heat treatment and surface processing services, as well as pollution control equipment contracting. Export sales constitute a significant portion of total revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Chun Yu competes in the global fastener and steel component industry against manufacturers from China, Southeast Asia, and South Korea. It positions itself as a high-quality, innovative supplier with strong R&D capabilities and a diversified product portfolio targeting niche markets such as aerospace and automotive. The company leverages certifications and product innovation to maintain competitiveness amid intense price competition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, Chun Yu reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$9.17 billion, an 8.33% increase from the previous year, with a net profit of NT$401 million, up 11.19%. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and profitability, supported by expanding production capacity and market demand recovery. Total assets were about NT$12.12 billion with equity of NT$5.13 billion, indicating a stable financial position.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chun Yu emphasizes high-quality, precision-engineered fasteners with certifications such as ISO 9001, IATF-16949, AS9100, and various international product marks. Its value proposition includes customized product development, rapid delivery, and sustainable manufacturing practices such as low-carbon products and waste acid recycling. The company also highlights its integrated supply chain management and strong R&D to meet evolving customer needs in specialized industries.
